deltas.description: Control change on Webhook receiver (edge zone). STRIDE: Spoofing: no authentication or signature check — any caller can trigger a workflow; Tampering: attacker-controlled request body is passed straight in as workflow trigger data; DenialOfService: unauthenticated synchronous execution with no rate limit; ElevationOfPrivilege: triggers workflows that run with stored credentials
deltas.recommended_action: Review the changed/removed control; restore it or document the compensating control in the baseline.

deltas.recommended_action: Confirm the new entry point is intended; add explicit authz + input validation, or route it through the gateway.
